asr.full_text: The Unique Life The Good and the Bad OK, Ladies and Gentlemen, good afternoon and good evening, Titus Bezerra Luz speaking here. First video of the year of 2016. So, it's getting full of new stuff, But let's recap first what OneCoin was in the beginning! At the end of 2014, OneCoin was launched. Around February of 2015 2015 we started our mining of our currency worth 50 cents of euro. Nowadays the numbers are so different. In a company that started a year and a half ago we're already surpassing today 1.3 million people, that is, have more of 1,300,000 distributors members One Coins, this company also has expressive numbers, never imaginable, and never imagined and never achieved we are the first multi-level marth company world to reach 1 billion dollars by billing in its first year. We are the first company to break the one million members members on your first year. Look, guys, OneCoin has making a difference on the multi-level market. Our currency was launched at 50 euros. Today it counts 4,95 euros. It has an annual valuation of more than 700% of appreciation in less than a year. We began our mining on February 21, 2015, we were reaching 1 year and the currency already reached 4.95 euros. Some months ago, we bought a digital market company a Con Logos ,which also allied itself to OneCoin and now this Monday we also joined the OPN Network Marketing a company of more than 400 thousand distributors a digital marketing company. A german company in which we now join It is joined to the onecoin family to add up and reach this huge number of more than 1.300.000 people. We a few months ago also we had problems with some payments not a payment problem, but with some payments and Dr. Roujat decided to solve the problem once and for all she purchased OnePayment, a payment platform at a worldwide level where you can pay in any part of the world This is our company, this is our manager, Mr. Rujak Natova, who recently participated at a World Economy Forum in Bulgaria, where the Bulgarian President, from that country, there were bank presidents there, talking about payments, the President of the Cyprus Europe president and Dr. Rujar, talking about the future of payments, too. We are a virtual currency company. Our currency comes from the success bitcoin had, but we corrected a few of the issues caused by Bitcoin, or at least what used to be, great companies, where the currency would be held where large corporations could take control, that's where they corrected these security issues, but we are already looking at these security devices Our currency will be 100% of the members. In fact, it is a very strong cryptocurrency. With a much larger coins number as bitcoins there are 21 million coins. It was able to have a global payment platform that will link it as a notary, you can buy it anywhere in the You will be able to make cash flow regardless of where the money is send to. This is incredible! In few years it will be possible for all money 30% to 40% in virtual currencies. With a payment solution of 50%, 60%, through debt cards. We have all that! nowadays, we are one of the biggest multilife market companies in the world. We have just 1,5years. We put in this 1,5years first put on the Multi-Level Market In the mission4home website We also have between the first 5 shares, 2 put This is not for nothing I see every now and then some leaders who'd tell me, we want today a serious business and at least one-and-a-half years but we don't stand for a year in the market we're here to build that history to be part of the world. As Paul Zempilser said a few years ago in his book The Next Trillion, what are the excuses you will give for your kids and grandchildren when they ask you about this GREAT opportunity, the ONE COIN? Which will pass through the payments of all world transactions, we are a global company operating in more than 204 countries. 200 more than 200 countries that will be able to use our currency with one million and three hundred of members in their network. And you? What will you say? What excuse will you give to people? Nowadays you can do such thing? Here's a new opportunity for you. As it already happens with bitcoin the big companies don't sell any bitcoin anymore, They buy it. Because... Why? Because they make loans to the whole world based on bitcoin. Based on bitcoin. You can also make part of that with oneCoin and then I'm going to ask you What side you want to be on? Do you want to be on the side of believers or who will ask or not ask for the leadership of the people for what it will be and i already agree with them the leadership of marketing multi-level or will it be just a matter of profits or you are just looking for exponential gains this is the biggest opportunity of all times one coin came to change the story so to you, welcome, take your decision come be part of this business that is's changing , breaking all world records that multi-level companies made. We are number 1. Welcome Tino Bezerra. For you who is in Europe speaking english, there have support in the Arab world, on Tunisia. We've got a team in Tunisia, we have a team in Africa through Mohammad Tababi and Anis Ramadan, we have that support in those countries and here in Brazil. One more news. In less than 15 days we're announcing the address of our Office here in Brasil, official Office of OneCoin. We already have accounts here in Brasil. We're going to have accounts on four main banks, to put it like that. Itaú, Bradesco, Caixa Econômica Federal and Banco do Brasil. We like to pay and we do, everywhere. Make your choice! It is in your hands your future and leave with a legality to your children and grandchildren. May God bless you! Stay with God. Tito Bezerra.
